entries.title: Centraal Station's two plaques: the cold welcome and the sergeant
entries.reason: Centraal Station is A-list: pitched on the plaques
entries.hook: A plaque admits the state "failed" the camp survivors it received here in 1945.

entries.title: Nieuwendijk 89, the photographer's front with Daguerre and Niépce
entries.reason: date of the front to confirm
entries.hook: A portrait photographer's front with putti taking pictures and medallions of the two inventors of photography.

entries.title: Sint Luciënsteeg, the gable stone wall
entries.reason: alley access during the museum rebuild
entries.hook: About 47 rescued gable stones on the museum's outer wall: a milkmaid, three moles, a skater.

entries.title: The neon HELP in the Voetboogstraat (Joes Kloppenburg)
entries.hook: Where a man died stopping a beating in 1997: a minute-by-minute plaque and HELP in neon overhead.

entries.title: Een zeegezicht aan het IJ, the tiled cycle tunnel
entries.reason: pitched on the art, not the station
entries.hook: 70,000 hand-painted tiles of a Rotterdam painter's herring fleet line the tunnel under the station.

entries.title: Rokin station: the archaeologists' wall and Manders' fountain
entries.hook: Thousands of metro-dig finds laid out by shape, not date; Queen Wilhelmina rides above on the Rokin.

entries.title: Annick van Hardeveld, the last courier
entries.hook: A 21-year-old courier shot on 4 May 1945 while the radio announced the surrender.

entries.title: Walk of Pride, queer names from the Dam to the Homomonument
entries.hook: Since July 2026 bronze-inlaid tiles with queer names run from the Dam to the Homomonument.

entries.title: Nieuwezijds Kolk, the castle under the street
entries.reason: no paving marker known; check on site
entries.hook: Foundations of a castle of about 1280, the city's oldest structure, found under the Kolk in 1994.

entries.title: Beurspassage, the "Amsterdam Oersoep"
entries.hook: A passage turned underwater canal: herring and bikes in the ceiling, bicycle-part chandeliers, a fish-head tap.

entries.title: The Dam shooting of 7 May 1945 and its 32 name stones
entries.reason: Dam is A-list: pitched on the stones; Victoria Hotel draft mentions the day
entries.hook: Name stones in the Dam's paving for those killed when Germans fired on the liberation crowd.

entries.title: Het Lieverdje and the words on the Spui
entries.hook: The little bronze boy where Provo began its happenings, with Lawrence Weiner's iron books in the paving.

entries.title: The last elm of the Stationsplein
entries.reason: station square is A-list: pitched on the tree
entries.hook: The sole survivor of 30 elms planted when the station was built, now ringed by young ones again.

entries.title: The bicycle garage under the water at Stationsplein
entries.reason: second source needed; panels' visibility unknown
entries.hook: 7,000 bikes nine metres under the water, with two 1965 sgraffito walls saved from a demolished institute.

entries.title: Art under Centraal Station: tomorrow's weather and a mosaic seen through peepholes
entries.hook: A screen landscape whose weather is tomorrow's forecast, and a granite mosaic glimpsed through peepholes.

entries.title: Canvas van Amsterdam on the Haringpakkersbrug, where the Haringpakkerstoren stood
entries.reason: Okay; changing work; gone tower (BC-03 lead)
entries.hook: A changing artwork on the bridge by the vanished herring packers' tower.

entries.title: Rokin 64, the Moor on the cornice
entries.reason: Okay; link to Bartholomeus de Moor unchecked; scout hint: group with Gouden Bril (AC-01)
entries.hook: A carved Moor on a cornice, used by Mapping Slavery to talk about colonial words.

entries.title: Hotel Polen fire, 1977
entries.reason: Okay; single source; no memorial found
entries.hook: 33 dead in the deadliest Dutch fire since the war; Rokin Plaza replaced the hotel.

entries.title: Olieslagerssteeg, leper house, oil pressers and Maison de Bonneterie
entries.hook: Oil pressers sold Haarlem oil as a cure-all here; a department store replaced the lepers' chapel in 1901.

entries.title: Oude Braak and the Nieuwezijds Armsteeg, the dike-arm lanes
entries.hook: Lanes on a dike breach and a curving dike arm, with the White Cube art space.

entries.title: Wijdesteeg, the mosaic alley
entries.hook: "They used to call this a filthy little alley": residents' mosaics in the Wijdesteeg.

entries.title: Vrankrijk
entries.hook: The squatted political club of the Spuistraat, still open.

entries.title: Kalverstraat 10, the booksellers' palace above the shops
entries.reason: Okay; or a Look for in "Look up in the Kalverstraat"
entries.hook: Minerva and Mercury above a shop window, where Rembrandt's print publisher kept shop from 1662.

enrich.draft: The newspaper street, from Handelsblad to De Standaard
enrich.add: the Handelsblad complex squatted in 1978, now social housing with "kruip door, sluip door" routes; the 1980s lesbian squat

enrich.draft: De Gouden Bril, the optician with a monkey on the roof

Politieposthuisje, the police post that became a public toilet and a café
